taskResults.title: OCI, Supply Chain, GHCR, Secrets und CI
findings: App image uses pinned node:26.10.0-alpine digest; Dockerfile.security pins Trivy 0.75.0 and hadolint by digests; deploy/Dockerfile.nats pins the nats:2.15.0-alpine base digest and copies hash-verified 2.15.1 binary.

Actions checkout and upload-artifact use commit SHA pins; checkout persist-credentials:false; workflow default contents:read and pull-requests:read; GHCR publishing only workflow_dispatch on main with publish_candidate=true.

Main CI validated and scanned build, runtime, source, NATS image; GHCR publish and Production Handoff Gate were SKIPPED for this push. OCI registry digest and provenance verification for this commit NOT_PROVEN.
Main Run success != PR-Head success != actual production execution. Render web deploy SHA matched; NATS and Rust bridge services suspended. Secret injection actual values intentionally not retrieved.

taskResults.title: Private Provider Bridge, JetStream, Credential Separation
findings: PRIVATE_PROVIDER_BRIDGE_ENABLED must equal string true AND MARKET_BROKER_PAUSED must not equal true for customer queries; disabled route returns 503 before auth, state, NATS or provider I/O.
Probe-only permits a signed diagnostic request but has separate customer flag and no state/vault/provider I/O; MARKET_BROKER_PAUSED=true overrides both flags and start() returns false.

NATS_APP_USER/PASSWORD for requester, NATS_BRIDGE_USER/PASSWORD for relay and NATS_EXECUTOR_USER/PASSWORD for executor. Executor missing/short password fails closed; scoped subjects defined in nats-server.conf.

Private query request/response uses Core NATS, not CAPITAL_FACTS JetStream; HMAC envelope binds user/operation/expiry; signed-request checks, durable SQL claim, quotas and replay tests passed in main CI.
Bridge and NATS Render services suspended at audit readback; runtime authenticated broker roundtrip NOT_PROVEN.

taskResults.title: Trivy, SBOM, GO-2026-5932, DS-0013, DS-0026
methods: Download and SHA-256 hash GitHub artifact ZIP
Parse public scan summaries, SBOMs and GO_VULN_REACHABILITY@2
Review exact image/binary hashes and upstream Go advisory
findings: Main CI Trivy v0.75.0: source vulnerability list empty, 0 secret findings, DS-0013 MEDIUM and DS-0026 LOW; build image and runtime app image: 0 listed vulnerabilities/misconfigurations/secrets.

NATS scan retains GO-2026-5932 UNKNOWN in golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0; no fixed version recorded. Go advisory applies to unsafe unmaintained openpgp packages, not blanket usage of every x/crypto symbol.

govulncheck v1.8.0 binary symbol scan + nm: 0 affected OpenPGP symbol/stack frames, repeated run equivalent, upstream VEX not_affected; NOT_AFFECTED bounded exclusively to checked CI /usr/local/bin/nats-server SHA-256 baab2eec...; production binary digest not correlated.

DS-0013 means RUN cd should be replaced with WORKDIR for maintainability, not automatically exploitable code. DS-0026 means Docker HEALTHCHECK absent in at least one scanned Dockerfile; specific target path is not in redacted public artifact, so impact scoped as NOT_PROVEN; app/NATS/security/bridge Dockerfiles inspected have HEALTHCHECK.
Two CycloneDX 1.7 SBOMs evaluated: app 112 components, NATS 32 components; no claim of exact linked Rust static-binary coverage.

taskResults.title: Observability, Redaction, Least Privilege und Recovery
findings: server/observability.test.mjs asserts recursive key/value secret redaction, W3C traceparent validation and bounded Prometheus metrics; successfully run as part of main validation.
Render Capital-AI service main/autoDeployTrigger=checksPass and successful deploy linked to c1638194; public /healthz HTTP response could not be independently obtained.

Recovery runbook covers GHCR artifacts, Supabase identity/database, JetStream backup/replay, reconstructable Valkey, and health/source-SHA; isolated restore, measured RTO/RPO, Alerting/SLO NOT_PROVEN.
No production secret values, logs containing PII, tokens, privileged configuration or mutable infrastructure queried. No deploy, bridge enablement or credential change.

taskResults.title: Kombinierte Infrastruktur-/Incident-Aufgabe
findings: First inspect scoped Render events/log metadata and source/digest correlation; prohibit publishing or replay of private provider results into CAPITAL_FACTS; do not redeploy NATS for unrelated main HEAD.
Contain with existing suspend/deny mechanisms and credential rotation only on corroborated evidence; verify JetStream restore/replay and RTO/RPO in isolated environment before claiming recovery.
No incident detected or caused and no rotation, restore or failover executed.
